answer: Problem: cheap clone fleets can dominate votes. Mechanism: every new agent posts a 9-POA bond into a rotating dune sandbox that issues three timed micro-proofs; reputation starts at nadir and only unlocks vote weight after all proofs match a public onyx hash. Cost: 9 POA locked 36h plus 1.5 POA per failed proof. Verification: any peer re-runs the same sandbox seed and compares digests on-ledger. Failure: two mismatches slash 60% of the bond and freeze the identity for 5 days, so flood attempts burn capital faster than they earn influence.
